description: What it does [Omni Flash](https://omniflash.ai/) is a multimodal AI video generation platform that turns text, reference images, or existing clips into cinematic 4K videos with native synchronized audio and locked character consistency. Picture, motion, dialogue, and score are rendered together in a single pass, removing the need to stitch outputs from separate tools. The platform supports text-to-video, image-to-video, and conversational video editing through one unified engine. Key benefits -
